name: WILL YOUR ANCHOR HOLD
confidence: read from a public-domain score, unchecked
reviewNotes: The melody line read from the Timeless Truths score of We Have an Anchor (https://library.timelesstruths.org/music/We_Have_an_Anchor/, We_Have_an_Anchor.xml, whose rights line reads “MUSIC: William J. Kirkpatrick, 1882. Public Domain.”), verse and refrain; only the tune was taken, not the harmony. Its opening agrees with hymnary.org's incipit 12316 22171 33225 (https://hymnary.org/tune/will_your_anchor_hold_kirkpatrick). No hand fixes. Kirkpatrick's dates (1838–1921) and the year 1882 are from the hymnary.org tune page.
